auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description: How the extractor authenticates to Azure Service Bus

options.tooltip:
**Connection string (SAS)** — a shared access policy of the namespace, queue or topic with **Listen** rights. Listing entity names in the rows and **Show Entity Details** also need **Manage** rights; with a Listen-only policy, type the names yourself.

**Service principal (Entra ID)** — an Entra ID app registration with the **Azure Service Bus Data Receiver** role. Required when the namespace has local (SAS) authentication disabled.

Found in the Azure Portal under **Shared access policies** of the namespace (or of the queue / topic). Use a policy with **Listen** rights and copy its **Primary Connection String**. A **Manage** policy additionally lets the rows list queues, topics and subscriptions and show entity details. **Test Connection** on this page also needs **Manage** rights — with a Listen-only policy, use **Test Connection** in a row instead.
The directory (tenant) ID of the Entra ID app registration — found on the app's **Overview** page in the Azure Portal.

The application (client) ID of the Entra ID app registration — found on the app's **Overview** page in the Azure Portal. Assign the app the **Azure Service Bus Data Receiver** role on the namespace (or on the queue / topic) under **Access control (IAM)**.
Created under the app registration's **Certificates & secrets**. Copy the secret's **value** immediately — Azure only shows it once.

Found in the Azure Portal on the namespace's **Overview** page as **Host name**. The service principal needs the **Azure Service Bus Data Receiver** role on this namespace (or on the queue / topic it reads).
